stories.title: First Pakistani astronaut to undertake space mission from China on Nov 25: Ahsan Iqbal
stories.brief: Pakistan’s first astronaut will undertake a space mission from a Chinese space centre on November 25, Planning Minister Ahsan Iqbal said on Sunday.

stories.title: Pakistan to launch first astronaut into space from China on Nov 25: Ahsan Iqbal
stories.brief: Planning Minister Ahsan Iqbal announced on Sunday that Pakistan’s first astronaut would embark on a space mission from China on November 25, as he set out the country’s ambitions for a lunar mission by 2035, state-run Radio Pakistan reported.

stories.title: Daniel Dubois delivers devastating second-round stoppage of Fabio Wardley to retain WBO title
stories.brief: Davison had been on the brink of throwing in the towel at the very end of the opening round but the bell sounded to end a disastrous first three minutes for Wardley. He was dropped heavily after just 17 seconds as Dubois landed a left cross followed by a pulverising right hand.

stories.title: 'Devastating & dramatic' - Dubois stops Wardley to retain title
stories.brief: Daniel Dubois underlines his status as Britain's leading heavyweight with a devastating second-round stoppage of Fabio Wardley to retain his WBO title in London.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz stresses equal opportunities in education to realize Quaid's vision
stories.brief: Recalling the initiative’s origins during his tenure as Punjab chief minister, PM Shehbaz questioned why children from affluent families could attend elite institutions while millions of equally talented children from poor households could not access comparable education.

stories.title: FM Dar, Iranian FM discuss regional situation, OIC meeting in Baghdad
stories.brief: In a post on X, the FO said the two leaders also discussed the next meeting of the R-4 grouping, comprising Pakistan, Egypt, Turkiye and Saudi Arabia, during a telephone conversation. “The two leaders exchanged views on recent regional developments," the ministry added.

stories.title: Maldivian president to visit Pakistan on Oct 20-22 as ties mark 60 years: FO
stories.brief: Muizzu will visit Pakistan at the invitation of Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, accompanied by First Lady Sajidha Mohamed and a high-level delegation comprising cabinet ministers and senior officials, according to the statement.

stories.title: Air Force officer killed in rappelling accident before UTSA’s game against Navy
stories.brief: He fell on to the field while rappelling down from the stadium rafters. He was treated on the field before being taken away on a stretcher.

stories.title: What are self-replicating ‘AI worms’, and why is Anthropic worried about them?
stories.brief: The red team, as such internal testers are called, said it created a malicious AI program that spread autonomously through internet-connected “smart” televisions and could do the same inside other ordinary devices.

stories.title: EPA quietly backtracks on claims US has phased out toxic Pfas compounds
stories.brief: Still, the EPA is allowing Houston-based Inhance to produce containers from which Pfoa has been found to leach at high levels into the containers’ contents. The company makes up to 200m plastic containers annually used across the US economy.

stories.title: Turning the tides: Could hidden sea power energise our coastal towns?
stories.brief: Engineer David Mummery has developed a tidal energy generator that he says can change lives for people living in coastal communities.

stories.title: ‘I felt disgusted’: MEP speaks out over nude deepfakes and urges EU action
stories.brief: When she opened the links, she found herself staring at images from one of her first ever press conferences – but the images had been digitally altered to remove her clothing.

stories.title: There's a crackdown on sports piracy - but is it already out of control?
stories.brief: The sports industry's lucrative business model is being undermined by dodgy TV sticks and illegal streaming links, writes Theo Leggett.

stories.title: How day of protests unfolded as disorder breaks out across France
stories.brief: Demonstrations across the country turned violent, with cars and buildings set alight and shops ransacked.

stories.title: ‘You can’t make this stuff up’: why we remain fascinated by Elizabeth Holmes
stories.brief: The Holmes he met in the green room was personable and pleasant. The Holmes he interviewed on stage was altogether different.“The accent changed: this deep voice, very serious,” Agus, a medical oncologist, recalls by phone from Los Angeles. “It was as if I had met a person and then interviewed a separate person.
